name: Writing Workshop
description: Study of different genres and styles of presentation of content; the building blocks of writing (sentence structure, paragraph building); exercises using samples to observe and reconstruct the structure of academic writing (paraphrasing, quoting, citing); exercises to build a long report through the preparation of proposal, title, abstract, main body (including introduction, sections, conclusion); exercises to prepare annotated bibliography, literature review.
